result.summary: The main interface is generally well-structured, but there is one significant visual inconsistency related to text readability.

issues.description: The '-20%' discount badge on the pizza image at the bottom is partially obscured or visually conflicts with the dark background styling, potentially making it harder to read.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the positioning or add a consistent background layer/contrast enhancement to the badge to ensure it remains legible against various restaurant background images.
